curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with the driver's primary duty and the speed and survival figures, then marked and unmarked crosswalks, stopping and yielding, signal changes, penalties, multi-lane stops, and pedestrian duties.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for marked versus unmarked crosswalks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on crosswalk duties and penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover where to slow for pedestrians, scanning before turns, crashes during turns and driveways, night and weather visibility, and pedestrians walking without sidewalks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per habit; a contrast card for pedestrian duties versus the driver's duty.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on where and when to watch for pedestrians.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain that motorcycle riders follow the same laws but react differently, following distance, being passed, the most common crash cause, road hazards for riders, and head-turn blind spot checks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for mirror checks versus head turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on following, passing and spotting motorcycles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach longer stopping in bad weather, no-zones behind and beside trucks, following farther back, rollback, wide right turns, passing and pulling back in, oncoming large vehicles, and yielding to buses re-entering traffic.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the bus re-entry rule versus lane changes and for the rear versus side no-zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on no-zones, passing trucks and the bus yield rule.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the rights of cyclists and skaters, the Safe Passing Law distance and speed, due caution, penalties, bicycle lighting at night, and yielding on right and left turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for right versus left turns and for injury versus no-injury penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on safe passing and turning near cyclists.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define mopeds and low-speed vehicles as the manual does, the motorized scooter ban and its requirements, what counts as a scooter, the mobility exception, and off-road vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per vehicle type; a contrast card for mopeds versus low-speed vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on small and off-road vehicle rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach train stopping distance and right of way, never racing a train, clearing the tracks, no passing near crossings, advance warnings, and crossing only at designated crossings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for clearing distance versus the no-passing distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on railroad crossing safety.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain slowing for horses, stopping when a rider signals, lighting for horse-drawn vehicles, and why swerving for animals is dangerous.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for slowing versus stopping near a horse.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on horses, horse-drawn vehicles and animals.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec13-m01..sec13-m08; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact
